# ORQO

> ORQO organizes customer conversations from WhatsApp, Instagram and Facebook Messenger in a shared workspace, with customer profiles, AI replies, team handover, automation and WhatsApp campaigns.

Canonical marketing host: https://www.orqo.site
English pages use `/`; Arabic pages use `/ar` and right-to-left layout. `/en` is a legacy English alias. Product capabilities and allowances should be checked against current product pages, pricing and a demonstration of the required workflow.

## Product and buying guides

- [Features](https://www.orqo.site/features): Verified messaging and team capabilities.
- [Solutions](https://www.orqo.site/solutions): Administrative communication workflows for online stores and clinics.
- [Comparisons](https://www.orqo.site/compare): Source-backed evaluations of respond.io, Wati and Manychat.
- [Alternatives](https://www.orqo.site/alternatives): Buying criteria and migration considerations.
- [Guides](https://www.orqo.site/blog): WhatsApp support, shared inbox processes and clinic enquiries.
- [Pricing](https://www.orqo.site/pricing): Current plans and usage allowances. Confirm channel charges separately.
- [Arabic overview](https://www.orqo.site/ar): Equivalent Arabic marketing content.
- [Contact](https://www.orqo.site/contact): Product questions and demonstrations.
- [Developer documentation](https://docs.orqo.site): Public REST API documentation.
